## Review checklist
- [ ] The change stays within scope; relevant tests and docs are updated.
- [ ] I ran the per-file offline checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/neerazz/hermes-antigravity-oauth/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#local-setup-and-offline-checks), or explained why not.
- [ ] I separated tested behavior from assumptions and live account checks.
- [ ] Auth, credential handling, process cleanup, and tool approvals are unchanged, or changes and risks are explained above.
- [ ] The diff and attached evidence contain no tokens, OAuth codes, private prompts, conversation databases, or account secrets.
